in_marathi.name: Sager
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sager हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sager derives from the Sanskrit word 'Saraswati' which means 'Goddess of knowledge, music, art, wisdom, and learning'. Saraswati is often depicted holding a veena, a stringed musical instrument, which represents the harmonious vibration of the universe. The name Sager is a modern variation of the name Saraswati and is given to children to bless them with the qualities of a healer and a protector.
